anova form a GLMM fitted with mmes

anova_mmes.Rd

anova method for class "mmes".

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mmes'
anova(object, object2=NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

an object of class "mmes"

object2

an object of class "mmes", if NULL the program will provide regular sum of squares results.

...

Further arguments to be passed

Value

vector of anova

Giovanny Covarrubias
